comparison.objective: Collect three litter items with a trigger-operated reacher and place them in a bin; the candidate adjusts a robot-gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Support and aim a long tool while pulling its trigger, grasping remote objects, and transporting them versus two-tool coaxial adjustment and counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Credit follows items lifted or deposited without direct gripper contact; candidate follows angular accuracy, nut retention, repeated motion, and released clearance.
comparison.reason: The shared use of two arms and a tool is generic; the tested remote grasp-and-transfer ability is unrelated to retaining a locked mechanical setting.
